formal_statement: ∃ f g : Fin 6 → ℂ, f ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ c : ℂ, g ≠ c • f) ∧ ∀ s r : ℂ, Matrix.permanent (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin 6) => (1 : ℂ) + s * f (j - i) + r * g (j - i)) = 720
plain_statement: There are two complex vectors f, g indexed by 0..5, f nonzero and g not a multiple of f, such that for all complex s and r the permanent of the 6 x 6 matrix with entry 1 + s f(j - i) + r g(j - i) (indices mod 6) equals 720, the permanent of the all-ones matrix: a level plane in the circulant algebra of order 6. Conjecture; level lines are known there by computation, no level plane (computed, not checked).
title: Probe: a two-dimensional space of 6 x 6 circulant complex matrices keeps the permanent of the all-ones matrix plus it at 720
